title: Starting with this super easy Banana Ghost
summary: Day 1/13 of toddler-friendly Halloween treats & food! I LOVE Halloween, but it can be hard finding cute Halloween treats that are actually suitable for toddlers—so for the next 13 days, let’s try some together!
caption: 👻🍌 Day 1/13 of toddler-friendly Halloween treats & food! I LOVE Halloween, but it can be hard finding cute Halloween treats that are actually suitable for toddlers—so for the next 13 days, let’s try some together! 🎃 Starting with this super easy Banana Ghost 👻 🍌 Cut 1 banana in half 🥣 Add Greek yogurt to a bag and snip the corner 👻 Drizzle it back and forth over the banana to make your ghost 🫐 Add crushed or small pieces of freeze-dried blueberries for the eyes and mouth  Most versions use candy eyeballs or chocolate chips, but I think freeze-dried blueberries do the trick for a toddler-friendly version! Such an easy way to make snack time a little more spooky. 🖤🎃 Follow along for Day 2/13! #toddlerfood #toddlerrecipes #easyrecipe #halloweentreats #halloween
